dog.description_text:
Olive is the cutest little Terrier mix puppy who weighs just under 9 lbs! This sweet and affectionate girl seems to think everyone she encounters is a potential new friend. Her tail starts wagging as soon as she spots a person or another dog, and she loves approaching strangers to say hello. She's quite the little social butterfly!

Olive may be tiny, but she's got a whole lot of love to give. Like any puppy, she's looking for a committed adopter who's excited to show her the ropes, help her learn good manners and provide the training and structure she needs to grow into a happy, confident adult dog.

Registered adopters interested in Olive can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
